reference_sql:
SELECT product_id,
       product_name,
       unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY unit_cost_eur, product_id
LIMIT 2
alternatives:
SELECT product_id,
       product_name,
       unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE launch_date >= '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY unit_cost_eur ASC, product_id ASC
LIMIT 2

SELECT product_id,
       product_name,
       unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY 3, 1
LIMIT 2

SELECT product_id,
       product_name,
       unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE NOT launch_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
ORDER BY unit_cost_eur NULLS LAST, product_id
LIMIT 2
